edit.Name: edit
edit.description: Edit the config file, example usage: 'oh-my-posh config edit'

export.Name: export
export.description: Export the config file, example usage: 'oh-my-posh config export --config ~/.config.omp.toml'

--output.Name: --output
--output.description: The file to output the migrated config to, example usage: 'oh-my-posh config export --output ~/.config.omp.json'

--error.description: The last exit code, example usage: 'oh-my-posh print primary --error 127'

--eval.description: Use eval to render the prompt, example usage: 'oh-my-posh print primary --eval'

--execution-time.description: Use last command execution time in millis, example usage: 'oh-my-posh print primary --execution-time 200'

--plain.description: Print a prompt without ASNI codes, example usage: 'oh-my-posh print primary --plain'
